{"metadata":{"description":"One macOS app for Claude Code, Codex, and every agent runtime you use — scheduled runs, global hotkey launcher, per-run git worktrees, one review board.","id":"gh:1281865940","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"cetus","slug":"drewnekota/cetus","topics":["ai","ai-agent","ai-agents","automation","claude-code","codex","coding-agent","computer-use","deepseek-harness","desktop-agent","desktop-app","dsh","dsh-plugin","llm","local-first","macos","productivity","rust","tauri","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"One macOS app for Claude Code, Codex, and every agent runtime you use — scheduled runs, global hotke"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"y launcher, per-run git worktrees, one review board."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"Human in the loop is the bottleneck."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Cetus is a desktop client for reviewing and managing the work of every agent you run — Claude Code, "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"Codex, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Grok Build, Kimi CLI, or the built-in runtime."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Official website · cetus.run"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Community"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"⭐️ Star the repo to get notified about new releases. To share feedback, scan the QR code with WeChat"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" to join the group chat."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Friendly links"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- LINUX DO — A community of idealists."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Why Cetus"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Agents are no longer the slow part. Claude Code, Codex, and DeepSeek Harness can work for an hour on"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" their own. What slows them down is the person they are waiting on: a permission prompt, a clarifyin"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"g question, a finished task that nobody has reviewed yet."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"And that person is usually juggling several products. Claude Code in one window, Codex in another, s"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"cheduled jobs that each report back in a different client. Every switch costs attention, and every m"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"inute you don't notice an agent waiting is a minute it sits idle."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Some tools, like Superset, put different runtimes side by side, but in a TUI. A terminal is a fine p"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"lace for an agent to run and a poor place for a person to read: everything is monospaced text, plans"},{"id":"p13s3","text":", diffs, and questions all look alike, and whatever scrolls off is gone."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Cetus is built for the human side of the loop: a real desktop app where every agent's work is easy t"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"o read, easy to answer, and easy to review."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## One client for every runtime"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Every runtime in one window.** Use the CLI you already have installed and signed in to. Cetus re"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"uses its login, model, and tools, so there is no second account to set up.
- **One place to respond."},{"id":"p16s3","text":"** Permission prompts, questions, and plans from any runtime show up as cards in the conversation. S"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"teer a running turn or queue the next message without waiting for it to finish.
- **One board for re"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"view.** Every conversation is a card in **In progress · Needs review · Done**. Finished work waits f"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"or you instead of scrolling away in a terminal.
- **Parallel without collisions.** Per-conversation "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"git worktrees let several agents edit the same repo at once."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Built around the same loop"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Everything else in Cetus exists to make your part of the loop shorter."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Threads — see all your sessions at once"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"A workspace feed where every message starts its own session, on whichever runtime you `@mention`. Op"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"en any thread docked beside the feed, and follow the activity badges to the next session that needs "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ny thread docked beside the feed, and follow the activity badges to the next session that needs you."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Quick Launcher — any runtime, one hotkey away"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Hold **both ⌘ keys** to summon an agent over any app. Cetus brings along the current screenshot, fro"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ntmost app, browser URL, and selected text as removable context chips, so you can ask in place inste"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ad of switching windows and explaining what you are looking at."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Automations — scheduled work lands in the same place"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Turn any prompt into a one-off or recurring job (`at` / `every` / `cron` / `daily`) on any runtime. "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"Each run works in a fresh background conversation and lands on the board for review, instead of repo"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"rting back in yet another client."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Less explaining"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The less context you have to type, the faster you get back out of the loop."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Screen context.** Cetus captures frames, dedupes them, and OCRs them on-device with Apple Vision"},{"id":"p27s2","text":", so the agent can recall what was on screen. Opt-in, with retention controls and an excluded-apps l"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ist.
- **Meeting memory.** Calls are transcribed on-device into searchable notes — text only, no aud"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"io stored. Ask "what did we decide about the launch date?" and the agent searches your meetings loca"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"lly. Off by default.
- **Dictation.** Hold a hotkey in any app and talk; Cetus types the cleaned-up "},{"id":"p27s6","text":"text wherever your cursor is.
- **Persistent memory** that you and the agent both edit, carried into"},{"id":"p27s7","text":" future conversations."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### And more"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Parallel solutions**: fan one prompt into N candidate runs, keep one, archive the rest
- **Cetus"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" Remote**, an optional Tailscale-backed phone companion for following runs and handling approvals aw"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ay from your desk
- **Computer and browser control**, with a confirmation step before anything conse"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"quential and a Stop button always in reach
- **30+ model providers** for the built-in runtime, inclu"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ding Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, Ollama, LM Studio, and OpenRouter"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Every capability that touches your screen, mic, or apps is opt-in, and everything stays on your Mac."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Get started"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Cetus runs on **Apple Silicon** Macs. There are two builds of the same app:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Build | Download | Requires |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| **Cetus** — the original app, built with Electron | Cetus.dmg | macOS 13+ |
| **Cetus Swift** (Bet"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"a) — a native SwiftUI build, still missing some polish | Cetus-Swift.dmg | macOS 15+ |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Both update themselves. Then:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"1. Open the DMG and move Cetus to Applications.
2. Use the built-in runtime, or pick an installed an"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"d signed-in `claude`, `codex`, or `dsh` (DeepSeek Harness) CLI.
3. Choose a workspace and give the a"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"gent its first task."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"> **Early release:** Cetus is under active development. Please open an issue if something breaks or "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"a workflow is missing."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
